messages:
jen: kicking off staged rollout for inference-service v3.4.1 -> 10% across us-east + eu-west. change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. deploy-bot will shift traffic. release notes https://internal/release/3.4.1 :rocket:

deploy-bot: starting traffic shift: inference-service:v3.4.1 -> 10% canary (us-east, eu-west). watch p95/p99 and 5xx.

ops_lee: quick glance — eu-west p99 edged up ~80ms in the last 3 min. not huge but noticed.

alex: any 5xx?

qa_ravi: 5xx stable (0.12% -> 0.13%). retry rate ticked +0.4%. no obvious content errors from QA checks.

maria: logs look like increased tail in long-running requests, maybe kv-cache miss pattern.

jen: ok pause any further ramps. keep at 10% while we triage.

alex: copying logs snippet:
```
[eu-west] p99: 240ms -> 320ms
5xx: 0.12% -> 0.13%
retries/sec: 42 -> 58
metric: kvcache.miss_rate: 0.06 -> 0.18
```

ops_lee: that kvcache spike matches an infra rollout we had earlier on proto nodes. can we isolate eu-west traffic to fallback version if it keeps climbing?

jen: yes — plan: hold at 10%, if eu-west p99 > 300ms OR 5xx > 0.5% we do a region-scoped rollback to v3.3.0. I want pinned fallback ready before any rollback. maria can you prepare the pin?

maria: creating migration + pin. pin job queued. command I'll run: `./tools/rolloutctl pin --svc inference-service --region eu-west --version v3.3.0`

qa_ravi: running quick scenario tests against v3.4.1 canary in eu-west, will report regressions in 2 min.

deploy-bot: traffic shift paused by jen. current state: global canary 10% (us-east 10%, eu-west 10%). no further changes applied.

qa_ravi: stress test passed for content parity. latency still elevated under synthetic long-tail cases.

alex: I'm leaning to soft regional rollback to remove risk. others?

ops_lee: +1 for regional rollback, we can keep global canary and leave us-east alone. rollback should be quick.

jen: do it. alex take the action and post the command output.

alex: executing: `./tools/rolloutctl rollback --svc inference-service --region eu-west --to-version v3.3.0 --type pin`

deploy-bot: action started: rolling inference-service in eu-west -> v3.3.0 (pin).

deploy-bot: action complete: eu-west now pinned to v3.3.0. traffic: eu-west 100% -> v3.3.0; global canary remains 10% (us-east).

ops_lee: eu-west p99 back down to ~230ms within 90s. 5xx unchanged.

maria: pin confirmed in infra console and config. added rollout note to the release doc.

jen: good — keep monitoring for 30m, then we can decide whether to iterate on v3.4.1 or re-run a canary after kv-cache fix. I'll open an incident ticket just to track the regional rollback and postmortem. tagging @oncall. :white_check_mark:

alex: noted. will follow up on infra change from earlier that may have caused the kvcache miss.

qa_ravi: will run extended regression overnight against a warmed cache set.

jen: thanks team. moving to observation state. if anything spikes tag this thread and call a quick sync.

deploy-bot: thread note: rollout paused -> regional rollback executed. audit id: RB-2026-0456.
